summary: pip options: break_system_packages, chdir, editable, executable (e.g. pip3.13, not with virtualenv), extra_args, name list with version specifiers or VCS URLs, requirements file, and state (present, latest, absent, forcereinstall).
questions: How do I pass --user or an index URL to pip?
How do I use pip for a specific Python version?
How do I install from a requirements.txt on the server?
How do I force reinstall a pip package?
How do I upgrade a pip package to the newest version?
How do I allow pip to install into the system Python on Debian 12?

answer_card.title: pip parameters (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `name`: list; version specifiers allowed; VCS URLs (`git+`, `hg+`, `svn+`, `bzr+`)
- `requirements`: path on the remote (relative to `chdir`)
- `state`: `present`, `latest`, `absent`, `forcereinstall`
- `executable`: e.g. `pip3.13`; can't combine with `virtualenv`
- `extra_args`: e.g. `--user`, `-i URL`
- `break_system_packages` (false): allow PEP 668 system installs
- `editable`, `chdir`
